records.title: Analyzing Latency Hiding and Parallelism in an MLIR-based AI Kernel Compiler
records.reason: 本文はedge向けMLIR AI kernel compilerにおけるvectorization, multithreading, double bufferingによるlatency hiding/parallelismを測定する。compiler lineageには近いが、特定LLM inference workloadの実証はなく転用可能性が未確定。

records.title: MARS: Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨を確認。Reward modeling is central to RLHF, RLAIF, and PPO-based alignment, but its reliability is often limited by scarce and heterogeneous human preference data. In this paper, we introduce MARS (Margin and Semantic-Aware Data Augmentation for Reward Modeling), an adaptive augmentation framework for controlled low-resource reward modeling.
